opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant lookup + recipe + note
opportunities.description: Search a restaurant site for a cuisine/area, open a restaurant, search Allrecipes for a matching dish, open the recipe, and save a 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note.
steps: Enter cuisine+area in restaurant search and submit
Open a restaurant result and read rating/price/area
Open the recipe and read time
Add a new note 'Dinner: out at <restaurant> (...) or cook <recipe> (...)'

opportunities.name: Stopover city: Wikipedia + Booking hotel + note
opportunities.description: Look up a city on Wikipedia, search Booking.com for a hotel on a given weekend date, and save a stopover note with hotel, price, sight and population.
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia for population/sight
Enter the city in Booking destination and pick the suggestion
Select check-in and check-out dates and search
Open the first hotel and note its price

opportunities.name: Family call email: timezone + weather
opportunities.description: For a city, check local time on timeanddate and 10-day weather, then draft an email to family announcing a call with a relative.
steps: Search the city on timeanddate and open its page
Search the city on the weather site and open 10 Day forecast
Compose email to family with subject 'Call with <person> on <day>'
Write body with local time, offset and forecast
